meta.title: Seedream Studio
meta.description: A visual workbench for Doubao Seedream image generation: write a prompt, pick a model and size, and add reference images by dropping them in, pasting a screenshot with ⌘V, or choosing files. Images are saved to $DSH_HOME/seedream-images by default, with no metadata JSON written, so the folder holds just your images plus a hidden .history.json (Finder hides it by default; macOS can still create its own .DS_Store). Open it from the viewfinder icon in the left sidebar; the same capability is exposed to the agent as the seedream_generate tool. Type @ in the prompt to reference uploaded images in upload order; references are highlighted in blue so they read differently from ordinary text. Recent generations let you select several images and delete them in bulk, or delete one at a time; deleting moves files to the Trash, where they can be restored. History is stored in .history.json inside the save folder, so it survives a DSH restart. Reference images are staged in a DSH temp folder and cleaned up when you remove one with × or uninstall the plugin (they are kept across generations so you can reuse them). Prompt enhancement only appends quality and lighting descriptors locally — no model call, no extra cost. This version supports Volcengine Ark Agent Plan only and accepts keys starting with ark-. Paste your key with the Configure key button at the top right; it is saved in the DSH credential store (ARK_AGENT_PLAN_API_KEY in ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml), never inside the plugin folder, so a key can never travel with the code into a repository. The panel shows only a masked fingerprint, never the secret itself. Failed requests are never retried automatically because every generation is billed, and 3K/4K, image sets, and web search are not supported — the UI disables them rather than silently degrading. Disabling the plugin only removes the panel and the tool; images already generated stay in the save folder.
